scope: Direct execution of actual Server._client_report_arrived with inert pickle report; no network or arbitrary-code payload. This proves entry-handler acceptance/mutation, not a complete aggregation exploit.
owner: Phase 2B socket identity acceptance already required by plan; coordinate bounded payload limits with 2D.
implementation_constraint: Bind to current server-issued logical client assignment/session, including reused physical workers, urgent async reports and edge servers. Comparing only original registration client_id would break valid multiplexing. Validate before pickle parsing or unrelated state mutation.
trust_boundary: Session binding is not cryptographic authentication and does not make pickle safe for untrusted peers.
